creditNotes_finalize.description: Finalize a draft Credit Note. If the type is `BEFORE_PAYMENT`, the `refund_amount` and `out_of_band_amount` must be null. If the type is `AFTER_PAYMENT`, you will need to allocate the `total_amount` of the credit note to either `refund_amount` or `out_of_band_amount`.

out_of_band_amount.description: Amount credited outside of Airwallex. Only applicable when the `type` is `AFTER_PAYMENT`.

refund_amount.description: Amount credited with refund. Only applicable when the `type` is `AFTER_PAYMENT`.

parameters.description: ID of the Credit Note object.
parameters.name: id

creditNotes_void.description: Void a finalized Credit Note. Transition from finalized to voided is allowed only when: 1) type of Credit Note is pre-payment 2) payment status of the linked Invoice is unpaid.

parameters.description: ID of the Credit Note object.
parameters.name: id

creditNotes_addLineItems.description: Create Line Items and add them to a Credit Note. This is only possible when the Credit Note status is `DRAFT`. You can only add 100 line items at a time. The bulk create operation is atomic, all the line items created with the request will either succeed or fail together.

line_items.description: A list of credit note line items to be added, you may add 100 items at a time and add up to a maximum of 1000 items per credit note.

amount.description: The amount of the credit note line item. You can specify either the `amount` directly, or the pair of `quantity` and `unit_amount`. When the `invoice_line_item_id` is null, this amount is proportionally distributed across all invoice line items based on their `remaining_creditable_amount`.

description.description: Description of the line item being credited.

invoice_line_item_id.description: ID of the Invoice Line Item.

invoice_line_item_group_id.description: A unique identifier that groups all related line items from a single tiered price. Used to credit by group instead of by individual line item. Mutually exclusive with `invoice_line_item_id`. When specified, `invoice_line_item_id`, `amount`, and `unit_amount` must be null. A single request cannot include both an `invoice_line_item_group_id` and any of its constituent `invoice_line_item_id`s. For `GRADUATED` prices, the credit amount is recalculated based on the remaining quantity. If the adjusted quantity no longer reaches a tier, associated fees (including flat fees) are automatically credited. For `VOLUME` prices, no tier adjustment is applied.

additionalProperties.description: A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

metadata.description: A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to this object for storing additional information.

quantity.description: The number of units of product being credited.

tax_included.description: Whether the `amount` or `unit_amount` are inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. Only can set the value to true for `unit_amount` when the price of the associated invoice line item is also tax inclusive. Defaults to false.

unit_amount.description:
The amount to be credited per product unit. This `unit_amount` will be multiplied by the `quantity` to get the full amount to credit for this line item. You can specify either the `amount` directly, or the pair of `quantity` and `unit_amount`. Only applicable when the `invoice_line_item_id` is not null.

Defaults to the unit amount of the invoice line item when `quantity` is provided.

parameters.name: id
